modules.responsibility: HTTP server, routing, payload parsing, and JSON envelopes
workflow commands and application persistence boundary
entities, validation, transitions, allocation, and pull sequencing
workspace state, atomic JSON persistence, seed data, and event journal
yard metrics, closure blockers, and deterministic summaries

workflows.name: Open a shift and classify an intake train
steps: validate shift and car manifest payloads
allocate cars to compatible standing tracks
persist classified cars and an intake event
workflows.success: the intake train is classified and every compatible car is standing on a track
workflows.failure: invalid codes, duplicate cars, or full incompatible tracks produce a stable error
workflows.verification: workflow check creates a shift and classifies a four-car intake through the HTTP API

workflows.name: Plan an outbound pull sequence
steps: select standing cars for a destination
derive actions, reserve cars, and persist a queued pull run
workflows.success: the sequencer returns a pull run and marks the outbound train planned
workflows.failure: unavailable cars, wrong destination, or impossible stack access produce a planning error
workflows.verification: workflow check plans an outbound consist and verifies the generated pull actions

workflows.name: Trial a candidate pull plan without committing
steps: deep-copy the current yard snapshot for isolation
run the same LIFO simulation core as formal planning
report feasibility, reversals, occupancy, blockers, and new or resolved conflicts
workflows.success: the trial returns the same verdict formal planning would give, without persisting anything
workflows.failure: the trial reports the same conflict codes formal planning would raise on that state
workflows.verification: workflow check covers no-reverse, needs-reverse, illegal order, and occupied inputs and restarts the service to confirm no state pollution

workflows.name: Execute pull actions and depart the outbound train
steps: advance the pull run through buffer and return actions
append planned cars to the assembled consist
complete the run and mark the outbound train departed
workflows.success: the assembled consist matches the planned consist and the train departs
workflows.failure: a mismatched stack top or unreserved car fails the current action
workflows.verification: workflow check executes every pull action and verifies train departure

workflows.name: Close a shift with a yard balance
steps: derive yard totals and occupancy metrics
collect closure blockers from open intakes and active runs
persist a closure snapshot and expose the yard view
workflows.success: a clean yard state produces a snapshot and the shift becomes closed
workflows.failure: open work or an occupied maintenance track prevents closure
workflows.verification: workflow check closes a shift and verifies the returned yard balance
